system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:32:09, taskhostw.exe on WS-MLOPEZ-01 attempted to use explicit credentials for svc-bkp against PROXY-HD-01. This is unexplained by the supplied inventory, which places the backup agent on FILE-HD-01; the record does not establish whether authentication succeeded.
At 13:42:39, WS-MLOPEZ-01 recorded a network logon for omar.haddad from WS-OHADDAD-01, followed by a privileged-logon event.

At 13:44:39, PowerShell ran as omar.haddad with the command to execute \\FILE-HD-01\IT\Deploy-Patches.ps1. The user, source workstation, and script match the stated IT patching practice, although this process start is later than the reported approximate 13:40 time.

The PowerShell process connected through the proxy to download.windowsupdate.com; shortly afterward it launched wusa.exe to install a Windows update package. This sequence is consistent with the stated patching activity.
